note: Example screenshots for the guided-calibration wizard. Every image must be a REAL, owner-approved capture of the game with personal data removed (names, chat, private overlays). No image ships until its entry has approved:true AND a file present; until then the wizard shows an honest 'example pending' placeholder, never a fabricated picture. Annotations use fractional coordinates (0-1) over the image: {type: point|rect|label, x, y, w, h, label}.
capture_instructions: Owner: open Roblox Prospecting at the target moment (see per-item alt text), then use the Capture-example button on the wizard's calibration page (dev build, owner machine only). Crop/redact in Preview if needed, re-save over the same file, then Approve.

roblox_window.alt: The Roblox Prospecting game window on the primary display, showing the river bank with the pan HUD visible.

cap_bar.alt: The pan-fill capacity bar completely full (all yellow), with the picker's confirm card on the detected RIGHT tip of the bar.

pan_prompt.alt: Standing in the water: the white 'Pan' prompt under the full capacity bar, with the picker's confirm card on the detected prompt pixel.

deposit_prompt.alt: Standing on land: the white 'Collect Deposit' prompt, with the picker's confirm card on the detected prompt pixel.

shake_prompt.alt: Mid-shake: the white 'Shake' prompt with the picker's confirm card on the detected pixel (the colourful pan-shake fills the background).

dig_green.alt: A dig in progress: the dig bar with its green target zone, magnified by the picker's loupe.

money_region.alt: The money counter in the lower-right corner with the picker's box-confirm card after dragging a tight box around the number.

shards_region.alt: The shards counter in the lower-right corner with the picker's box-confirm card after dragging a tight box around the number.

find_region.alt: A dragged find pop-up box on the right side of the screen where finds appear, with the box-confirm card.

fortune_river.alt: The Fortune River / Fast Travel panel open with the picker's confirm card on a captured point.

autopan_button.alt: The Auto Pan button showing its ON (green) state, with the picker's confirm card on the captured ON colour.

cue_masks.alt: The cue-mask editor after clicking the 'Pan' prompt word: kept letters glow green; the card below confirms or restarts the selection.
